reference: You can hear his enormous sneeze in the meadow.
sk: Jeho obrovské kýchnutie môžeš počuť po celej lúke.
cz: Jeho obrovské kýchnutí můžeš slyšet po celé louce.
acceptable: You can hear his {enormous|huge|giant|massive} sneeze {in the|all over the|across the|across the whole|over the whole} meadow.

mistakes.text: You can to hear his enormous sneeze in the meadow.
You can {listen|listen to} his enormous sneeze in the meadow.
His enormous sneeze you can hear in the meadow.
Can you hear his enormous sneeze in the meadow?
mistakes.feedback_sk: Nie je to otázka: „You can hear…“.

mistakes.text: You can hear his enormous sneeze in the whole meadow.

source_issues: SK/CZ say 'all over the meadow' (po celej lúke / po celé louce); reference has 'in the meadow'.
